q: QPR finished their 1975-76 league programme top of the table, a point clear of Liverpool, who still had a game to play. At which ground was that title-deciding match played ten days later?
hint: Liverpool's rearranged final fixture was away at Wolves, who needed to win it to stay up.

q: Loftus Road, QPR's home since 1917, sits in which part of west London?
hint: The ground is a short walk from the White City site, in the W12 postcode.

q: QPR laid an artificial pitch at Loftus Road in 1981. In which year did they dig it up and go back to grass?
hint: The plastic lasted seven seasons before being removed in the April of that year.

q: Who scored QPR's equaliser late in extra time of the 1982 FA Cup final at Wembley?
hint: It was a defender who would later win England caps and eventually join the very club that beat him that day.

q: QPR reached the FA Cup final for the only time in 1982. Which club beat them after a replay?
hint: The north London side were retaining the trophy, having also won a replayed final the year before.

q: Rodney Marsh left QPR in March 1972 for a then club-record fee. Which club did he join?
hint: Malcolm Allison paid £200,000 to take him to Maine Road. He had originally arrived at QPR from Fulham in 1966.
